title: AST Node Classes and Pretty Printer
description: Dataclass nodes for AST and a recursive pretty printer that walks the tree, printing each node with indentation to show structure.

steps.description: Reveal imports: dataclasses and typing for node definitions.
Reveal node classes: Num, Str, Bool, Var, BinOp, UnaryOp, Assign, Print, Block, If, While as dataclasses.
Reveal pretty: recursive tree walk that prints each node type with indentation.

steps.question: What is the top-level operator for tree1?

steps.description: Reveal tree1: AST for (2+3)*4 with BinOp('*') at root.
Reveal tree2: AST for 2+3*4 with BinOp('+') at root, showing different precedence.
Focus on match statement: one case per node type with recursive calls for children.
